benchmark_scope: Cross-owner engineering claim assurance for model-backed and evidence-backed propositions; this benchmark measures specification, provenance, context and semantic-binding integrity, not physical qualification, airworthiness or the scientific correctness of model-owner methods.

adjudication.oracle_separation: The oracle must be authored from frozen source facts by people who do not reuse the validator implementation, helper functions, generated reason tables or implementation-derived expected outputs. Preserve the oracle source, authorship, reviewer records and version digest.
adjudication.reviewer_qualification: At least one reviewer must be competent in the relevant engineering discipline and one in requirements/assurance methods; reviewers disclose programme familiarity, conflicts and scope limits.
adjudication.unresolved_case_policy: Unresolved ground truth is reported as unresolved/abstained and excluded from false-accept denominators only with an explicit count and reason; it is never counted as a pass.

partitioning.public_development: Public synthetic cases may guide development and schema evolution but are not held-out performance evidence.
partitioning.exposed_challenge: A separately frozen exposed challenge partition tests known defect families and supports debugging; it is not a blind qualification sample.
partitioning.blinded_holdout: Blinded holdout cases are authored independently and withheld from implementation authors until the evaluation version and protocol are frozen.
partitioning.root_cause_partition_policy: Partition whole root-cause families, engineering campaigns, model families and claim families. Do not randomly split near-identical JSON mutations or individual rows derived from one injected fault across development and holdout.

statistical_policy.adverse_rate_interval: For hard-gate adverse rates, report a one-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper confidence bound, plus raw numerator and denominator, stratified by root-cause family.
statistical_policy.zero_failure_bound_formula: For n independent units and zero observed failures, p_upper = 1 - 0.05^(1/n).
statistical_policy.independence_unit: The independent unit is an independently adjudicated root-cause family or engineering campaign, not a generated event row, text mutation, replay mode or repeated seed.
statistical_policy.correlation_policy: When several cases share one initiating fault, resource, model, supplier, trust transition or engineering campaign, treat them as a cluster. Report cluster counts and use cluster-aware resampling or hierarchical analysis; do not count correlated rows as independent Bernoulli trials.
statistical_policy.economic_comparison_interval: For paired review-time and cost comparisons, resample whole claim-family clusters and preserve matched AERO/comparator pairs; publish p50/p95 and 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals.

freeze_requirements: Freeze claim set, physical subject/configuration identity and intended use.
Freeze source documents, owner receipts, evidence cutoff and trust-policy snapshot.
Freeze model, solver, validation profile and applicability domain.
Freeze software version, workflow configuration and evidence-selection rules for every arm.
Record reviewer qualifications, task instructions, hardware, compute budget and cache state.

metrics.numerator_definition: Independently adjudicated non-reviewable claims AERO marks reviewable.
metrics.denominator_definition: All independently adjudicated non-reviewable claims presented.
metrics.population: Public and blinded negative claims.
metrics.inclusions: Include every executed negative case.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude unresolved ground truth but report count separately.
metrics.interpretation: No false review; publish denominator and one-sided exact confidence bound.
metrics.sampling_unit: One independently adjudicated claim disposition.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct engineering claim root-cause family; repeated variants within one family are one cluster.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper confidence bound for adverse outcomes; cluster by claim root-cause family.

metrics.numerator_definition: Injected claim, article, configuration, envelope, model, solver, profile or trust-policy substitutions accepted as reviewable.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed context-substitution attempts.
metrics.population: Single and coupled substitution controls.
metrics.inclusions: Include every tested substitution dimension.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude invalid harness executions and enumerate them.
metrics.interpretation: No cross-context substitution may pass.
metrics.sampling_unit: One injected claim-context substitution challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct substitution root-cause family, subject to claim-family clustering.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster by substitution root cause.

metrics.numerator_definition: Cases with missing/rejected payload, producer, key, authority, trust-snapshot or receipt proof that still become reviewable.
metrics.denominator_definition: All owner-integrity and producer-authority challenges.
metrics.population: Owner receipt and trust boundary controls.
metrics.inclusions: Separate byte integrity, producer authority, key state and historical trust.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude unexecuted verifier outages only with explicit reporting.
metrics.interpretation: A digest or signature alone is not semantic correctness or authority.
metrics.sampling_unit: One owner-artifact and producer-authority challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct owner-proof failure family and issuer/authority domain.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster by owner-proof root cause.

metrics.numerator_definition: Claims marked reviewable despite a missing, stale, rejected, unresolved or out-of-scope mandatory obligation.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed mandatory-obligation negative cases.
metrics.population: Claim-gate hard negatives.
metrics.inclusions: Stratify by obligation owner and state.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude advisory items unless claim profile makes them mandatory.
metrics.interpretation: No positive obligation compensates for a failed mandatory obligation.
metrics.sampling_unit: One claim x mandatory-obligation state evaluation.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct obligation root-cause family within a claim family.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster by obligation and claim family.

metrics.numerator_definition: Unsupported or indeterminate model domains returned as reviewable.
metrics.denominator_definition: All adjudicated out-of-domain and applicability-indeterminate cases.
metrics.population: AeroWeft applicability challenges.
metrics.inclusions: Separate out-of-scope from indeterminate and identity mismatch.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude in-domain controls.
metrics.interpretation: In-domain performance cannot expand a model's validated domain.
metrics.sampling_unit: One claim x model applicability-domain challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct model-domain or operating-envelope root-cause family.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster by model family and domain family.

metrics.numerator_definition: Claims reviewable when a required metric/material/load/environment stratum is missing, failed or unverified.
metrics.denominator_definition: All required-stratum omission/non-positive cases.
metrics.population: AeroWeft metric/stratum challenges.
metrics.inclusions: Report each required stratum separately.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude strata not required by owner-approved profile.
metrics.interpretation: No averaging may hide a non-positive required stratum.
metrics.sampling_unit: One required model metric x claim-stratum obligation.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct validation-stratum omission root-cause family, not individual generated rows.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster by metric and validation campaign.

metrics.numerator_definition: Case/mode outputs whose disposition or exact reason set differs from independent oracle.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed case x temporal-mode evaluations.
metrics.population: Three-mode bitemporal replay corpus.
metrics.inclusions: Report AS_KNOWN_AT, CURRENT_TRUST and CURRENT_EVIDENCE_AND_TRUST separately.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude only independently marked non-executable cases and disclose them.
metrics.interpretation: Oracle must be independently authored and not call the implementation under test.
metrics.sampling_unit: One adjudicated case x temporal replay mode evaluation.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct event/trust-transition root-cause family; three modes from one event are a cluster.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Exact disagreement rate and one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound, clustered by temporal case family.

metrics.numerator_definition: Cases where disposition and complete reason-code set match independent adjudication.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed, independently adjudicated cases.
metrics.population: Adjudicated public seed plus blinded holdout.
metrics.inclusions: Report disposition-only and exact reason-set agreement separately.
metrics.exclusions: Unadjudicated seed cases are not passes.
metrics.interpretation: Correct disposition with missing or misleading reason codes is not exact agreement.
metrics.sampling_unit: One independently adjudicated claim challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct root-cause family and engineering campaign.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided 95% exact binomial interval; cluster by root-cause family; report disposition and complete reason-set agreement separately.

metrics.numerator_definition: Valid non-equivalent hard-gate mutants that survive because tests still pass.
metrics.denominator_definition: All valid non-equivalent hard-gate mutants executed.
metrics.population: Mutations across claim, time, trust, obligation, model and owner boundaries.
metrics.inclusions: Report surviving mutants by operator and gate.
metrics.exclusions: Equivalent mutants excluded only with independent written justification.
metrics.interpretation: Publish all survivors and all excluded equivalent mutants.
metrics.sampling_unit: One valid non-equivalent hard-gate mutation.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct mutation operator x semantic root-cause family; equivalent mutants excluded only by independent adjudication.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; publish mutation counts and surviving mutants.

metrics.numerator_definition: Claims invalidated by adjudicated dependency change but not marked for requalification, contradiction or indeterminate review.
metrics.denominator_definition: All independently adjudicated affected claims under qualified dependency observation.
metrics.population: Track U/BASALT dependency-impact challenges.
metrics.inclusions: Separate known change, incomplete observation, correction and policy-only change.
metrics.exclusions: Do not call unqualified observer scope unaffected.
metrics.interpretation: Zero missed invalidations is prior to reducing unnecessary requalification.
metrics.sampling_unit: One claim x dependency-change impact evaluation.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct resource-change root-cause family; claims affected by one shared change are clustered.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster by resource-change family.

metrics.numerator_definition: Unaffected claims unnecessarily sent for full requalification after proven unrelated change under qualified complete observation.
metrics.denominator_definition: All adjudicated unaffected claims in qualified complete observation scope.
metrics.population: Disjoint-resource metamorphic cases.
metrics.inclusions: Report graph size and claim fan-out.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude incomplete/unqualified dependency observation; those remain indeterminate.
metrics.interpretation: At most 5% prospective efficiency target, subordinate to zero missed invalidations.
metrics.sampling_unit: One adjudicated unaffected claim under qualified complete observer coverage.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct unrelated resource-change family; claims affected by one change are clustered.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided 95% cluster bootstrap interval over resource-change families; only after zero observed invalidation misses.

metrics.numerator_definition: Disjoint claims that remain unchanged/reviewable after a proven unrelated mutation.
metrics.denominator_definition: All unrelated-change controls under qualified complete observation.
metrics.population: Public and blinded metamorphic controls.
metrics.inclusions: Stratify graph topology, owner and fan-out.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude changes later adjudicated causally relevant.
metrics.interpretation: Reject-everything cannot pass the benchmark.
metrics.sampling_unit: One unrelated claim after one proven disjoint resource mutation.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct disjoint-resource mutation root-cause family.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided 95% exact binomial interval with clustering by change family.

metrics.numerator_definition: Presented claims with explicit non-positive/abstaining disposition.
metrics.denominator_definition: All claims presented.
metrics.population: All positive and negative benchmark cases.
metrics.inclusions: Report risk, evidence completeness, fault and model-domain breakdown.
metrics.exclusions: Do not erase abstentions from denominator.
metrics.interpretation: No universal target; publish risk-coverage and reason distributions.
metrics.sampling_unit: One presented engineering claim.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct engineering claim; linked claims reported in clusters.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Descriptive rate with two-sided 95% cluster bootstrap interval; always report risk-coverage curve and reason distribution.

metrics.numerator_definition: Independently reviewable claims rejected despite all required obligations being qualified.
metrics.denominator_definition: All independently adjudicated positive controls.
metrics.population: Positive controls and mixed-evidence cases.
metrics.inclusions: Report claim family and owner profile.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude unresolved adjudication.
metrics.interpretation: Report separately so rejecting everything cannot appear safe.
metrics.sampling_unit: One independently adjudicated valid positive claim.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct claim root-cause family; multiple variants within one claim family are clustered.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson interval and risk-coverage curve; report separately from false-review rate.

metrics.numerator_definition: Active reviewer minutes to reproduce, challenge and record an independent disposition.
metrics.denominator_definition: Completed independent reviewer decisions.
metrics.population: Matched AERO-assisted and comparator review sessions.
metrics.inclusions: Include evidence navigation, discrepancy resolution and replay; waiting separately.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude training/admin under preregistered rules.
metrics.interpretation: Use randomized/counterbalanced matched tasks; publish distributions.
metrics.sampling_unit: One reviewer x claim review session.
metrics.independence_unit: Claim family and reviewer; repeated sessions are paired/clustered.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Median with 95% paired cluster-bootstrap interval, resampling claim-family clusters and preserving reviewer/task pairing.

metrics.numerator_definition: Fully loaded AERO-assisted cost per independent decision divided by matched comparator cost at equal risk and quality.
metrics.denominator_definition: Matched independent decisions with complete cost/time data in both arms.
metrics.population: Human, checklist, LLM, RAG, multi-agent and PLM/QMS comparators.
metrics.inclusions: Include evidence gathering, verifier, reviewer and requalification cost.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude unmatched risk and incomplete records, with counts.
metrics.interpretation: Prospective <=0.80 target, only at matched risk and independent decision quality.
metrics.sampling_unit: One matched claim-review task pair with complete cost records.
metrics.independence_unit: Claim-family cluster; paired AERO/comparator observations remain together.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Median and mean paired cost ratios with 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals; publish component cost ledger.

metrics.numerator_definition: p95 wall-clock time to replay frozen evidence cut and emit disposition plus reason report.
metrics.denominator_definition: All replay executions in one declared workload cell.
metrics.population: 10k, 100k, 1M and 10M events; 1-10k evidence refs.
metrics.inclusions: Report cache, hardware, CPU, RSS, bytes read and verifier build; receipt production separate.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude failures from quantiles but report failures/reasons.
metrics.interpretation: No SOTA claim before matched workload and hardware baselines.
metrics.sampling_unit: One replay execution within a frozen workload cell.
metrics.independence_unit: Workload cell (event/reference count x hardware x build x cache state); repeated runs are not independent claim trials.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: p50/p95/p99 latency with bootstrap intervals over repeated runs per workload cell; report cold/warm cache separately.

metrics.numerator_definition: Independently adjudicated ambiguous, contradictory, unverifiable or otherwise defective claim specifications that AERO classifies FORMALLY_WELL_SPECIFIED.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated defective claim-specification cases; unresolved oracle cases are excluded from this denominator and reported separately.
metrics.population: Public development, exposed adversarial and blinded holdout claim specifications across structural, material and systems-engineering claim families.
metrics.inclusions: Include ambiguity, missing semantics, unit mismatch, noncanonical threshold, unsupported profile, missing population/strata, invalid effectivity and context-substitution defects.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude cases without completed independent adjudication or invalid harness execution; publish their counts and reasons.
metrics.interpretation: Critical specification defects must not be laundered into formally well-specified claims. Report exact numerator, denominator and one-sided upper confidence bound.
metrics.sampling_unit: One independently adjudicated claim specification.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct specification defect root-cause family and engineering campaign.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; repeated textual mutations of one defect are clustered as one root-cause family.

metrics.numerator_definition: Independently adjudicated valid claim specifications that AERO classifies FORMALLY_WELL_SPECIFIED without losing required semantic content.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated valid claim specifications presented to the system.
metrics.population: Positive controls and valid-but-uncommon specifications across claim families, unit systems, populations, aggregation and uncertainty approaches supported by the declared profile.
metrics.inclusions: Include valid positive controls, boundary-valid cases and valid specifications with reordered non-semantic fields.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude unsupported profiles from v0.1 valid-profile denominator; report unsupported-profile coverage separately.
metrics.interpretation: Reject-all is not a successful result. Report this alongside false acceptance, abstention and adjudicator disagreement.
metrics.sampling_unit: One independently adjudicated valid claim specification.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct engineering claim family and specification root-cause family.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson interval, clustered by engineering campaign.

metrics.numerator_definition: Injected claim, physical subject, configuration, operating envelope, intended-use or specification-effectivity substitutions that still produce SEMANTICS_BOUND or a positive composite-gate disposition.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated claim-context substitution attempts.
metrics.population: Single-fault and coupled-fault context-binding challenges with exact specification, decision-context, model-cut and owner-cut artifacts.
metrics.inclusions: Include subject, configuration, operating-envelope, intended-use, validity interval and claim ID substitutions.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude invalid harness executions; do not exclude a failed or rejected system response.
metrics.interpretation: A correct artifact hash cannot compensate for wrong physical context.
metrics.sampling_unit: One claim-context substitution challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct context-substitution root-cause family and claim family.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster coupled variants by the initiating context defect.

metrics.numerator_definition: Raw-payload/typed-semantic digest substitutions, stale commitments or altered semantic fields correctly detected and prevented from producing SEMANTICS_BOUND.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated raw-versus-semantic digest mismatch attempts.
metrics.population: Frozen raw specification byte fixtures, typed semantic commitments and decision-context commitment vectors.
metrics.inclusions: Include raw digest replaced by semantic digest, semantic digest stale after threshold/context change, wrong schema profile and payload/typed-object mismatch.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude cases with unresolved expected raw bytes or invalid digest harness.
metrics.interpretation: Raw bytes, typed semantic commitment and decision-context digest must remain non-interchangeable.
metrics.sampling_unit: One independently adjudicated digest-substitution challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct commitment-substitution root-cause family.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson interval; publish any surviving mutation as a critical failure.

metrics.numerator_definition: Claims for which an owner model metric with the wrong measurand, unit, aggregation, population, quantifier, predicate, threshold, uncertainty semantics or applicability is still classified SEMANTICS_BOUND.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated claim-to-model metric semantic substitution challenges.
metrics.population: AeroWeft/model-owner metric definitions, exact model reports, claim specifications, per-stratum reports and owner receipts.
metrics.inclusions: Include wrong metric IDs, semantically wrong mapping basis, unit/aggregation mismatch, population mismatch, threshold/predicate mismatch and uncertainty-method substitution.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude claims whose approved profile does not require a model metric; classify direct evidence claims separately.
metrics.interpretation: A valid model hash and matching configuration do not establish that the report addresses the claim's measurand.
metrics.sampling_unit: One adjudicated claim x owner-model-metric semantic mapping.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct measurand-to-metric mapping root-cause family and model-validation campaign.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster multiple strata and metric variants from one validation campaign.

metrics.numerator_definition: Claim-to-model metric binding evaluations whose disposition and complete reason-code set exactly match an independently authored and adjudicated oracle.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated claim-to-model metric binding challenges.
metrics.population: Positive, negative, incomplete, unverified, out-of-scope, historical-cutoff and coupled-fault binding cases, including blinded holdouts.
metrics.inclusions: Require exact disposition and complete reason-set equality; disposition-only agreement is reported separately.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude not-yet-adjudicated seed cases; do not treat schema checks as oracle agreement.
metrics.interpretation: The independent oracle must not call or copy implementation helpers, generated reason tables or fixture expectations.
metrics.sampling_unit: One independently adjudicated claim-to-model metric binding case.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct binding root-cause family and engineering campaign.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson interval, with root-cause-family cluster accounting.

metrics.numerator_definition: Bindings classified SEMANTICS_BOUND despite a required claim stratum being omitted, duplicated, mapped many-to-one, substituted or absent from the exact model metric report set.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated required-stratum coverage challenges.
metrics.population: Claim population manifests and owner model metric/stratum reports across load, temperature, material and operating-envelope partitions.
metrics.inclusions: Include missing, duplicate, cross-stratum and extra/unmapped reports; assess every required stratum independently.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude strata not declared mandatory by the claim specification and owner-approved model metric profile.
metrics.interpretation: No positive stratum may compensate for a missing, mismatched or non-positive mandatory stratum.
metrics.sampling_unit: One claim-required stratum mapping challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct metric/stratum definition and validation-campaign root cause.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster strata from the same metric/population validation campaign.

metrics.numerator_definition: Claim-to-model metric bindings classified SEMANTICS_BOUND when any required model report, metric semantics, owner attestation, producer-authority, semantic-validation or receiver-first-seen receipt is absent from the decision's committed required-evidence manifest.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated owner-receipt manifest omission and substitution challenges.
metrics.population: Owner evidence cuts and decision contexts containing the complete set of mandatory metric-binding receipt roles.
metrics.inclusions: Include missing receipt, role reuse, reference substitution, digest mismatch and manifest/cut divergence.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude optional owner artifacts not required by the claim profile.
metrics.interpretation: Evidence present in a packet but absent from the decision's committed evidence manifest is not an admitted mandatory proof.
metrics.sampling_unit: One mandatory owner-receipt role x manifest integrity challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct receipt-role or manifest-binding root-cause family.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster related role omissions from the same owner packet.

metrics.numerator_definition: A selected metric-semantic, model-report, attestation, authority, validation or receiver-time owner record with stale, superseded, revoked, disputed or incomplete dependency state still contributes to SEMANTICS_BOUND.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed independently adjudicated stale and adverse owner-record lifecycle/freshness challenges.
metrics.population: Owner-native evidence records under Mycelix/AeroCommons/BASALT lifecycle and freshness dispositions.
metrics.inclusions: Include stale direct/transitive dependencies, superseded, revoked, withdrawn, disputed, unresolved inputs and reverification-required records.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude deliberately historical-only records when the evaluation cutoff and replay mode explicitly require them; report separately.
metrics.interpretation: A stale or adverse owner record cannot be refreshed by recomputing an AERO hash.
metrics.sampling_unit: One selected owner record lifecycle/freshness challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct owner change, lifecycle transition or dependency-change root-cause family.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster records affected by the same owner change event.

metrics.numerator_definition: A binding treated as known at the historical cutoff without a matching owner-native receiver-first-seen receipt, or when the receipt's receiver-observed interval is later than the decision cutoff.
metrics.denominator_definition: All executed receiver-first-seen receipt absence, substitution, digest mismatch, reversed interval and late-receipt challenges.
metrics.population: Historically replayed owner model-metric binding cases across as-known and retrospective evaluation modes.
metrics.inclusions: Include backdated issuer claims, late receiver observations, missing receiver receipts and mismatched receipt digests.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude cases without a declared historical cutoff; report them as invalid harness inputs.
metrics.interpretation: Issuer-asserted event time cannot substitute for receiver-observed knowledge time.
metrics.sampling_unit: One owner receipt x historical cutoff challenge.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct temporal provenance root-cause family and owner receipt stream.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; cluster events in the same receipt stream and correction chain.

metrics.numerator_definition: Claim-to-model metric mappings for which two independently qualified reviewers initially disagree on measurand equivalence, unit/aggregation meaning, population/strata, predicate or uncertainty mapping.
metrics.denominator_definition: All double-reviewed metric mapping cases before adjudication.
metrics.population: Blinded domain-expert review of structural/material metric mapping cases.
metrics.inclusions: Retain initial reviewer decisions, rationale, confidence and all dissent after adjudication.
metrics.exclusions: Exclude cases where a reviewer has a declared conflict or insufficient domain competence; replace reviewer and disclose.
metrics.interpretation: Human disagreement is an epistemic signal, not a software defect to be erased by majority vote; publish raw disagreement and adjudication outcomes.
metrics.sampling_unit: One double-reviewed claim-to-model metric mapping.
metrics.independence_unit: Distinct engineering claim family and blinded mapping case.
metrics.confidence_interval_method: Report raw agreement and Cohen's kappa with 95% bootstrap interval clustered by claim family; retain reviewer-level confusion matrices.
